data.name: Echo's Inc
data.detailed_description:
At Echo's Inc, people don't quit. They vanish.

As a VHS archivist, your job is simple: review the body-cam footage of missing employees and file a report. Don't ask questions. Don't dig deeper.

Melvin disappeared three weeks ago. His tape just hit your desk.

What starts as a routine review pulls you deeper into something the building has been hiding for years and the further you watch, the harder it gets to tell where Melvin ends and you begin.

Explore. Observe. Survive.

Echo’s Inc is a first-person psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere and environmental storytelling.

  • Immersive first-person exploration

  • Psychological horror without combat

  • Tense, logic-driven puzzles

  • Hidden areas that reward curiosity

  • Story discovered through documents and audio logs

  • Environmental clues that piece together a larger mystery

The horror lives in the environment.

  • Volumetric lighting and thick fog blur dreams and reality

  • Unnatural shadows that feel almost alive

  • Subtle visual distortions and post-processing effects

  • Shifting spaces that create unease

  • Sound design that keeps constant psychological pressure

  • Narrative-driven psychological horror

  • Immersive, tension-focused experience

  • No combat — pure atmosphere

  • Story told through environments and subtle details

  • Hidden content for replayability

  • A focused 30-45 minute experience

data.short_description: You work the late shift at Echo's Inc reviewing bodycam footage of employees that vanished. Tonight it's Melvin's tape. You press play and suddenly you're not watching anymore. You're him. Living his last shift.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains intense horror elements designed to create a chilling and immersive experience. The content includes:

    Graphic Horror Themes: The game features vivid and unsettling horror scenarios, including depictions of fear-inducing environments and supernatural occurrences.
    Violence: There are scenes of violence that are integral to the horror experience. These depictions are intended to enhance the atmosphere and sense of dread.
    Swearing: The game includes strong language to maintain an authentic and intense horror experience.

Please note that while the game does not contain depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm, the atmosphere and content are designed to be disturbing and frightening. Viewer discretion is advised.
